description: Quantitative finance role with C++, Python, and financial modeling requirements

input.jobDescription:
Quantitative Developer at Apex Capital

Apex Capital is a systematic hedge fund managing $8B in assets. We seek a Quantitative Developer to build high-performance trading infrastructure.

Responsibilities:
- Develop and optimize low-latency trading systems in C++
- Implement quantitative models in Python for backtesting and signal generation
- Build data pipelines ingesting Bloomberg and Refinitiv market data feeds
- Collaborate with quant researchers to translate models into production code
- Manage risk systems and real-time P&L monitoring

Required Skills:
- C++ (C++17/20, templates, memory management, multi-threading)
- Python (NumPy, pandas) for quantitative analysis
- Strong understanding of financial instruments: equities, futures, options
- Bloomberg Terminal and Bloomberg API (BLP)
- SQL and time-series databases
- Linux and low-latency systems programming

Qualifications:
- BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or Financial Engineering
- 3+ years developing in a quantitative finance environment
- Experience with FIX protocol a plus

Apply at apexcapital.com/careers
